data_sources.name: OpenSky Network REST /api/states/all (bbox query)
data_sources.limits: anonymous ~400 credits/day, 1-4 credits per call by area, 10 s resolution; adapter: bbox only (never the global feed), 60 s cache, >=10 s between calls, area cap ~Europe
data_sources.terms: free for research/non-commercial use; attribution The OpenSky Network https://opensky-network.org

data_sources.name: Open-Meteo forecast API
data_sources.limits: free tier <10 000 calls/day, non-commercial; adapter: 60 s cache, 1 s polite interval

data_sources.name: USGS earthquake GeoJSON summary feeds
data_sources.limits: static feeds updated every minute; 60 s cache

data_sources.name: Natural Earth GeoJSON (countries 50m, populated places 10m), raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso
RainViewer radar (upstream layer)
data_sources.limits: NOT exposed as a tool here

tools.permission_class: category=read, permission=browser.read (network read of public data, not DANGEROUS), default_effect=auto, external_output=true
hardening: per-host polite interval (OpenSky 10 s, others 1 s)
hard timeouts (OpenSky 20 s, Natural Earth 60 s, others 15 s)
lists capped at 50, content <= 6000 chars, map 20..160 x 8..60
network/HTTP/JSON failure -> error 'данные недоступны: <source> (<reason>)', never a value
country = Natural Earth polygon (point-in-polygon), not only its bbox
tools.cli: python -m bcc.geo map --region europe (also aircraft|weather|quakes|daynight; --json; --ansi); non-interactive, prints once, exit 2 when a source is unavailable
